critical_code_review_comments: DeepAnalysis.jsx:95 and AngleRewrite.jsx:82 now use the reason STRING as the React key (key={r}). This removes the index-key warning but reintroduces a duplicate-key risk whenever the LLM/heuristic emits the same reason string twice in one list. Prefer a composite key such as key={`${idx}-${r}`} or key={`${factorKey}-${idx}`} (the pattern already used in ViralityScore).
Leaderboard.jsx:53 uses key={e.id || i} — fine, ids are always present from the API. Leaderboard.jsx:37 skeleton keys are now literal strings: correct.

VoiceButton.jsx: catch blocks now log via console.debug; the remaining bare `catch {}` at rec.start() correctly surfaces a toast, so no silent failure remains. Unsupported-browser path renders a disabled-looking mic + toast and never throws — verified no crash.

Playbook items 2-5 (httpOnly cookies, CORS allow-credentials with explicit origins, 5-attempt brute-force lockout, seed_admin password refresh) remain NOT implemented — localStorage + JWT Bearer is the intentional design per the request.
